purpose: Current-source evidence for the four workspace guides; no runtime or live acceptance
facts: Plugins page registers AWS/Azure/GitHub workflows and curated skills; membership required; storage failure labels Unknown. Catalog installation/enable/disable/remove is owner/admin, same-origin, commercial-access checked; guidance never grants tool permissions.

MCP page supports reviewed Microsoft Learn only. Check connection does not install; search requires enabled stored skill, membership/access, public technical query and audited bounded request. No arbitrary server URLs or Azure account access.
Workspaces page is recovery destination, no tenant reads; directs sidebar selection then Open workspace. Need inspect selector/service before documenting switching.
Settings web has Profile/Security/Sessions. Sign-in email/roles not edited by profile; paired desktop sessions independent. Need inspect profile API/session revocation and desktop distinction.

Workspace selector appears with >1 workspace or no current match. POST requires same origin, authenticated session and accepted membership; writes selection cookie, redirects to /control. Selection does not create membership or switch desktop session.
Profile PUT trims/collapses whitespace; name length1..80; current user only. UI update uncertainty says refresh before retry.

Web Sessions GET filters current user active sessions to current organization; DELETE rejects pairing not owned by that user/current organization. Browser signout and paired desktop revocation are distinct.

Skill mutations can write state before required audit fails; unconfirmed UI locks further actions until refresh. Guidance updates next Agent message, not old conversations, and grants no credentials/tool permissions.
